definition.title: TRAINING ONLY - Community software exercise
definition.notes: Review the current catalog first. Reuse an existing matching definition rather than publishing another version. Preserve all existing records. Use normal authorization and publication impact checks.

responder_practice.initial_notes: Fictional Resgrid app form exercise. Created in Responder to verify the department form, draft readback, and finalization.
responder_practice.updated_notes: Fictional Resgrid app form exercise. The department form and saved draft were reviewed in Responder before finalization.
next_steps: Inspect the actual current record and any open file chooser before another operation. The interrupted upload may have partially executed.
Reopen and verify persisted Notes through the ordinary UI. Capture the settled view after loading completes.
If attaching the fixture, check whether it is already present before selecting it again. Capture actual completion and classification.
Review the complete exercise record before attesting accurately. Finalize only through the available normal QuickEntry flow and capture the actual result.
Read the record back in Core. Do not treat a server draft reference as its finalized record number.

historical_core_practice.note: Historical identifiers are evidence, not seed IDs to insert. A new recording produces its own IDs, timestamps and sequence numbers.
